blocks.value: Deletes ONLY the Concert data that traces back to a single git repo (the application it was registered under, plus that application's own source_repos/packages/risks/actions via cascade) - safely on a SHARED Concert instance, since applications not linked to this repo are never touched.

inputs.value:
`"""
Script to delete ONLY the Concert data that traces back to a single git
repo - safe to run against a SHARED Concert instance (one also used by
other teams/demos - this must never touch data it didn't create itself):
  1. Look up the source_repo(s) in Concert whose repo_url matches
     gh_repo_url exactly (server-side filter by base64-encoded repo_url,
     confirmed live to return only the exact match, not a substring/fuzzy
     one).
  2. For each matching source_repo, read its own detail to find which
     application(s) it is associated with (associations.applications) -
     a source_repo lists its parent application(s) by id/name, confirmed
     live against this instance's real banco-kokunas source_repo.
  3. Delete only those application(s) via the core API. Deleting an
     application cascades to its own source_repos, packages, exposures
     (the risks/findings) and any remediation actions tied to them
     (confirmed live: this is the same cascade Reset_Demo relies on) -
     so this alone removes the application, its risks and its actions
     without a separate delete call for each. Applications that are NOT
     linked to this repo (e.g. a manually-registered legacy app, or
     another team's app) are never touched.

This uses subprocess.run() to execute curl, never use "shell=True" on
user-provided input!!

Input parameters (variables injected by workflow):
- gh_repo_url:           [required, string]  Repo URL exactly as registered in Concert,
                          e.g. "https://github.com/kokunas/banco-kokunas" (no ".git" suffix,
                          no trailing slash - must match the repo_url Concert stored at
                          ingestion time, since the lookup below is an exact match, not fuzzy)
- concert_url:            [required, string]  URL of the Concert API Gateway
- concert_api_key:        [required, string]  API Key to authenticate upon Concert
- concert_instance_id:    [required, string]  Instance ID to clean up
"""

import json as jsonlib
import base64
from subprocess import run, PIPE, DEVNULL
from sys import exit as sys_exit


def obfuscate(input_str):
    if not input_str or len(input_str) <= 8:
        return "*" * len(input_str or "")
    return input_str[0:4] + ("*" * (len(input_str) - 4))


def curl_json(method, url, headers=None):
    command = ["curl", "--silent", "--show-error", "--request", method, "--url", url]
    for h in (headers or []):
        command.extend(["--header", h])
    result = run(command, check=False, stdout=PIPE, stderr=PIPE)
    stdout = result.stdout.decode("utf-8").strip() if result.stdout else ""
    try:
        parsed = jsonlib.loads(stdout) if stdout else {}
    except jsonlib.JSONDecodeError:
        parsed = {"_raw": stdout}
    return result.returncode, parsed


# Install curl (Python FaaS image is alpine-based, curl is not preinstalled)
try:
    run(["apk", "add", "curl"], check=True, stdout=DEVNULL, stderr=DEVNULL)
    print("curl successfully installed")
except Exception as e:
    print("ERROR - Could not install curl:", e)
    sys_exit(1)

print("Input parameters")
print("=" * 100)
print("gh_repo_url         :", gh_repo_url)
print("concert_url         :", concert_url)
print("concert_api_key     :", obfuscate(concert_api_key))
print("concert_instance_id :", concert_instance_id)
print("=" * 100)

concert_headers = [
    f"Authorization: C_API_KEY {concert_api_key}",
    f"InstanceId: {concert_instance_id}",
]
base_url = concert_url.rstrip("/")

# Shared-instance safety: look up ONLY the source_repo(s) matching this
# exact repo_url - never list/scan every source_repo in the instance to
# guess a match, and never touch an application this repo isn't linked to.
encoded_repo_url = base64.b64encode(gh_repo_url.encode("utf-8")).decode("ascii")
repos_url = f"{base_url}/core/api/v1/source_repos?repo_url={encoded_repo_url}"
rc, repos_data = curl_json("GET", repos_url, concert_headers)
matching_repos = repos_data.get("source_repos", []) if rc == 0 else []

if not matching_repos:
    print(f"No source_repo found in Concert for '{gh_repo_url}' - nothing to delete "
          f"(this is safe/idempotent: either it was never scanned, or it was already removed)")
    sys_exit(0)

print(f"Found {len(matching_repos)} source_repo(s) matching '{gh_repo_url}':")
for sr in matching_repos:
    print(f"  - {sr.get('name')} ({sr.get('id')})")

# Resolve each matching source_repo to its parent application(s) - only
# these applications get deleted, nothing else in the instance.
apps_to_delete = {}
for sr in matching_repos:
    sr_id = sr.get("id")
    detail_url = f"{base_url}/core/api/v1/source_repos/{sr_id}"
    rc, detail_data = curl_json("GET", detail_url, concert_headers)
    if rc != 0:
        print(f"ERROR - Could not fetch source_repo detail for {sr_id}:", detail_data)
        sys_exit(1)
    linked_apps = (detail_data.get("associations") or {}).get("applications") or []
    for app in linked_apps:
        apps_to_delete[app["application_id"]] = app.get("application_name")

if not apps_to_delete:
    print(f"source_repo(s) for '{gh_repo_url}' exist in Concert but are not linked to any "
          f"application - nothing to delete")
    sys_exit(0)

print(f"Deleting {len(apps_to_delete)} application(s) linked to '{gh_repo_url}' "
      f"(cascades to that application's own source_repos/packages/risks/actions):")

apps_url = f"{base_url}/core/api/v1/applications"
for app_id, app_name in apps_to_delete.items():
    rc, _ = curl_json("DELETE", f"{apps_url}/{app_id}", concert_headers)
    print(f"  deleted application '{app_name}' ({app_id}): {'ok' if rc == 0 else 'FAILED'}")

print(f"Done - all Concert data for '{gh_repo_url}' removed. "
      f"Any other application/source_repo in this instance was left untouched.")
`

meta.description: Deletes only the Concert data tied to one git repo: finds the source_repo matching gh_repo_url, resolves its parent application(s), and deletes just those - cascading to that application's own source_repos/packages/risks/actions. Every other application/source_repo in the instance is left untouched.
